title: Best cornet players when Tom was young
summary: Tom names the best old-time cornetists, Naum Manetta, George Moret, Picou and others, why they were good, and Dude who played in the district; the reel ends garbled.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: Oh, you got car property down in the country? Yeah. Who was the best cornet player when you were young?

When I was young, old man. Now, the best cornet player was Nauman and Fess's uncle. And then the old man used to lead that band, Verrett. George? George Verrett and Emmanuel coming after them. Them were all the best cornet players at the time. So, Lizard, them, they could play, you know, but they wasn't like them fellas. He was old French, but he didn't know the music. You understand? Old man is correct. Well, he was hard. He was an old man, but he was hard. George Murray.
And this fellow was playing Clannett William, who died. Picou.
Well, what made them the best? Eh?
Well, of course, they read the music, they know it.
Did they have a good range? Could they go up high?
Go up high, go up as high as anybody else. Could they go down low?
Go down low, too. What kind of tone did they have? Well, they had good tone. They had good tone. Yeah.

And they could phrase good and everything? Oh, yeah. They had good tone. Now, I thought they called a diet, and he had a nice tone, too. Well, they used to play in the district there. Oh, I don't know, I forgot his name. I used to play in his place there, in the district. You used to play in his place? Yeah, I played in Jimmy. Jimmy used to play while in that, in the district, I don't know. Yeah, I used to go there and play in his place. What place was this? I called him Franklin, between, Franklin between, between St. Louis and, between St. Louis and the, . . . .
This is reel four of Tom Albert, May the 7th, 1962. Now we're talking about that corner player. He used to go take Kolaos.
Dude, he used to call him Dude, but I don't know the rest of his name.
